CONTENT SUMMARY:
================

1. ci.yml
   - 6 parallel jobs: lint, typecheck, test, build, security, summary
   - Triggers: push to main/develop, PRs to main
   - Runtime: 5-10 minutes
   - Python 3.12, Node 20, Ubuntu latest
   - Caching enabled for pip and npm

2. deploy-check.yml
   - Pre-deployment verification gate
   - Triggers: push to main only
   - Runs all checks + environment safety
   - Prevents .env commits and hardcoded secrets

3. ruff.toml
   - Line length: 120 characters
   - Rules: E, W, F, I, N, UP, B, SIM
   - Per-file overrides for tests
   - Import sorting with isort
   - Naming conventions enforcement

4. pyproject.toml (UPDATED)
   - mypy: Python 3.12, ignore-missing-imports, strict optional
   - pytest: test discovery, async mode, markers, logging
   - coverage: source exclusions, report format

VERIFICATION CHECKLIST:
======================

Run these to verify setup:

```bash
# Check files exist
ls -la .github/workflows/ci.yml
ls -la .github/workflows/deploy-check.yml
ls -la engine/ruff.toml
ls -la engine/pyproject.toml

# Check syntax (basic)
grep "^name:" .github/workflows/ci.yml
grep "^jobs:" .github/workflows/ci.yml

# Test locally
cd engine
ruff check . --config ruff.toml
mypy . --ignore-missing-imports

# Count lines
wc -l .github/workflows/*.yml engine/ruff.toml
```
